scope: Measurement archive is copied byte-for-byte. Every explicit receipt original is embedded reversibly or copied verbatim; length/SHA and direct byte equality verified.
Nested source/build/binary/ZIP inventories are provenance references, not recursively embedded payloads. CI artifact ZIPs and Node binaries are deliberately not copied.
Setup npm cache, raw performance directory and roundtrip tree are not duplicated; measurement/ already preserves every measurement original.
Upstream source-review is a structured paraphrase of official sources, not raw webpage HTML.
The old archive and current raw acceptedBaseline/PENDING/classifier labels remain unchanged.
Data in setup/harness-sources.json is archival source evidence, not a new repository entrypoint.
Index inventories all sibling files except itself; its physical hash is recorded in the external publication proof and later commit review.
All 16 external stdout/stderr streams referenced by the historical Windows validation phases are embedded, including empty streams; original receipts and results are unchanged.
